headline: Iran War Odds Through 2026
status: Tracking runs to Dec. 31, where the odds are limited war 66%, escalated 13%, MOU-style 14% and comprehensive 7%. Iran's forces claim three more tankers set ablaze by mines and Kpler puts Hormuz oil flows at about 45% of prewar, but the ships are unnamed and unconfirmed, so no tripwire fires; a Houthi missile shot down near Medina and an unconfirmed claim on Riyadh's airport hit Saudi territory, not the East-West line or Bab el-Mandeb, so the odds hold while Washington weighs its post-midterm options.

bets.cond: Iran accepts US sequencing, or round two is set with text
Iran ends strait tolls and permits, or declares Hormuz open to all shipping
Iran offers a concrete cut in enrichment capacity, in text or on the record
